newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Wife Naina says Yeltsin works a lot.
newsitem.headline: Wife Naina says Yeltsin works a lot.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, who celebrated his 66th birthday on Saturday, is recovering from pneumonia he caught last month and works many hours a day in his country home, wife Naina said in a television interview.
"He starts his work really early, at four or five a.m.," she told ORT television. "He works many hours during the day."
Yeltsin, who was treated in hospital last month for pneumonia, is now convalescing in his Gorki-9 residence outside Moscow.
Doctors say that Yeltsin's pneumonia has nothing to do with the quintuple bypass surgery he underwent last November. But Naina said the coincidence was bad luck for Yeltsin.
"It so happened that he had undergone the operation and later caught pneumonia," she said. "Doctors say that if it were just a normal man he should have still stayed in hospital."
Naina added that she thought her husband's passion for work also caused problems.
"He started working in hospital after the operation," she said. "It takes longer to recover if you work at the same time."
Yeltsin appeared three times in his Kremlin office after leaving hospital on January 20 and he is due to meet visiting French President Jacques Chirac on Sunday.
The Kremlin office says that Yeltsin is busy working on papers most of the time.
Naina remarked though that the president's work should not be measured by the number of his working and official meetings.
"He has said that his job was to think first of all," she said. "Now he has more time to think, to weigh things."
